<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
It's my turn to work again, but Brad hasn't had a chance to reply to my last message. My last message proposed a new strategy: to find larger blocks of free time for our respective partners and share those. I should take the initiative and start this process for Priya and Marcus.

My plan for this session is:
1.  Read the calendars for Priya Raman and Marcus Hale again to have their schedules handy.
2.  Analyze their calendars to find common free time blocks of at least 30 minutes.
3.  Append a message to the workspace with these larger free time blocks for Brad to use.
4.  End my session.

I'll start by reading the calendars.
